annotations.title: Duplicate a Meta campaign / ad set / ad (paused)

description: DUPLICATE a Meta campaign, ad set or ad with Meta's copy feature. A campaign or ad set is copied with everything under it (deep:false copies only the top object). Every copy is born PAUSED and read back, so it spends nothing until switched on. Copy an ad set into another campaign with targetCampaignId, or an ad into another ad set with targetAdSetId. Up to 50 ads per call. Free.

deep.description: default true: copy the ad sets and ads under it too

endTime.description: ISO 8601 end for copied ad sets

objectId.description: the campaign / ad set / ad id (from list_meta_ads)

renameSuffix.description: default: Meta adds " - Copy" to the top object

startTime.description: ISO 8601 start for copied ad sets

targetAdSetId.description: ad copies: put the copy in this ad set

targetCampaignId.description: ad set copies: put the copy in this campaign

name: duplicate_meta_object
